decision.explanation: Both Anna of Holstein-Gottorp and Lucinda Mary Fane de Salis are cited as spouses of John Brinsley Brooks in separate documents. Document D1 (1575) identifies Anna of Holstein-Gottorp as his spouse, while Document D2 (modern era) identifies Lucinda Mary Fane de Salis as his spouse. Since both claims are independently sourced and refer to different individuals, they are treated as distinct valid answers.
